question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Reckon
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Relieve
Think
Terminate
Release
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Think

Reckon - Think

Explanation:
"Reckon" means to consider or regard something in a particular way, which aligns closely with the meaning of "think."
"Reckon" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को एक विशेष तरीके से मानना या समझना, जो "think" के अर्थ के समान है।

Other synonyms Words:
Consider, Believe, Suppose, Deem, Judge

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Reckon – गिनती करना / मानना – To consider or regard in a particular way
Example: "I reckon it will rain today."

Relieve – राहत देना – To alleviate pain or distress
Example: "The medicine helped relieve her headache."

Think – सोचना – To use one's mind to consider or reason about something
Example: "I think we should leave early."

Terminate – समाप्त करना – To bring to an end
Example: "The company decided to terminate the contract."

Release – मुक्त करना – To set free or let go
Example: "The authorities will release the prisoners soon."

Conclusion:
"Think" is the most appropriate synonym for "reckon" because both words involve the act of considering or forming an opinion. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.Recluse
(MTS Non Tech Havaldar CBIC and CBN Examination 2024 Extra Time)
options: Closeness
Sociable
Candid
Solitary
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Solitary

Recluse - Solitary

Explanation:
A "recluse" is someone who prefers to live alone and avoids the company of others. "Solitary" means being alone or isolated, making it the best synonym.
एक "recluse" वह व्यक्ति होता है जो अकेले रहना पसंद करता है और दूसरों की संगति से बचता है। "Solitary" का अर्थ है अकेला या एकांत, जो इसे सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द बनाता है।

Hermit, Loner, Isolated, Withdrawn, Secluded

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Recluse – एकांतप्रिय – (A person who lives alone and avoids others)
Example: "The old man was a recluse who rarely left his house."

Closeness – निकटता – (The quality of being near or intimate)
Example: "The closeness between the two friends was evident."

Sociable – मिलनसार – (Fond of company; friendly)
Example: "She is very sociable and enjoys parties."

Candid – स्पष्टवादी – (Truthful and straightforward)
Example: "He gave a candid opinion about the project."

Solitary – एकाकी – (Being alone; isolated)
Example: "He led a solitary life in the mountains."

Conclusion:
"Solitary" is the best synonym for "recluse" because both words describe someone who prefers isolation. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Recommend
(Constable GD 2021)
options: Adhere
Oppose
Reward
Approve
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Approve

Recommend - Approve

Explanation:
"Recommend" means to suggest or endorse something as suitable or good, while "Approve" means to officially agree to or accept something. Both words involve expressing a positive opinion or support.
"Recommend" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को उपयुक्त या अच्छा बताना, जबकि "Approve" का अर्थ है आधिकारिक तौर पर सहमति देना या स्वीकार करना। दोनों शब्द किसी चीज़ के प्रति सकारात्मक राय या समर्थन व्यक्त करने से संबंधित हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Suggest, Advocate, Endorse, Propose, Support

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Recommend – सिफारिश करना – To suggest something as good or suitable.
Example: "The doctor will recommend the best treatment for your condition."

Adhere – पालन करना – To stick firmly or follow closely.
Example: "You must adhere to the rules of the institution."

Oppose – विरोध करना – To be against something or someone.
Example: "Many people oppose the new law."

Reward – पुरस्कार देना – To give something in return for good behavior or work.
Example: "The company will reward employees for their hard work."

Approve – स्वीकृति देना – To officially agree to or accept something.
Example: "The manager will approve your leave request."

Conclusion:
"Approve" is the best synonym for "Recommend" because both involve expressing support or agreement, though "Approve" is more formal and official. The other options either mean something different or are unrelated in context.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Reconnoitre
(CHSL 2021 Tier I)
options: Overlook
Disclaim
Inspect
Glance
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Inspect

Reconnoitre - Inspect

Explanation:
"Reconnoitre" means to make a preliminary inspection or survey, especially for military purposes. "Inspect" is the correct synonym as it also means to examine something carefully.
"Reconnoitre" का अर्थ है प्रारंभिक निरीक्षण या सर्वेक्षण करना, विशेष रूप से सैन्य उद्देश्यों के लिए। "Inspect" सही पर्याय है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी चीज को ध्यान से जांचना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Survey, Scrutinize, Examine, Explore, Investigate

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Reconnoitre – जासूसी करना – To make a preliminary inspection or survey.
Example: "The soldiers were sent to reconnoitre the enemy's position."

Overlook – अनदेखा करना – To fail to notice or consider something.
Example: "She overlooked the small error in the report."

Disclaim – अस्वीकार करना – To deny any responsibility or support for something.
Example: "The company disclaimed any liability for the faulty product."

Glance – झलक – A quick or brief look.
Example: "He took a glance at the newspaper before leaving."

Inspect – निरीक्षण करना – To examine something carefully.
Example: "The officer came to inspect the construction site."

Conclusion:
"Inspect" is the most appropriate synonym for "reconnoitre" as both involve a detailed examination, unlike "overlook," "disclaim," or "glance," which have different meanings.

question:

Recover

(Constable GD 2021)
options: Refrain
Remain
Regain
Retain
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Regain

[Recover] - Regain

Explanation:
"Recover" means to get back something that was lost or to return to a normal state. "Regain" also means to obtain something lost or to recover possession of something.
"Recover" का अर्थ है कुछ खोया हुआ वापस पाना या सामान्य स्थिति में लौटना। "Regain" का अर्थ भी खोई हुई चीज़ को वापस पाना है।

Other synonyms Words:
Retrieve, Recoup, Reclaim, Restore, Recuperate

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

[Recover] – पुनः प्राप्त करना – To get back something lost or return to a normal state.
Example: "She is trying to recover her lost documents."

[Refrain] – बचना – To avoid doing something.
Example: "Please refrain from making noise in the library."

[Remain] – बने रहना – To stay in the same place or condition.
Example: "He decided to remain silent during the meeting."

[Retain] – बनाए रखना – To keep or continue to have something.
Example: "She managed to retain her position in the company."

[Regain] – फिर से प्राप्त करना – To get back something lost.
Example: "He worked hard to regain his health after the illness."

Conclusion:
"Regain" is the best synonym for "Recover" because both words mean to get back something lost. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

Rectify

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.Recumbent
(Stenographer Grade C and D Examination 2024 )
options: Prostrate
Upstanding
Review
Upright
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Prostrate

[Recumbent] - Prostrate

Explanation:
"Recumbent" means lying down or reclining, and "prostrate" also means lying flat, especially face downward. Both words describe a similar physical position.
"Recumbent" का अर्थ है लेटा हुआ या आराम से बैठा हुआ, और "prostrate" का अर्थ भी जमीन पर लेटा हुआ, विशेषकर मुंह के बल। दोनों शब्द समान शारीरिक स्थिति को दर्शाते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Lying, Reclining, Supine, Horizontal, Prone

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

[Recumbent] – लेटा हुआ – Lying down or reclining
Example: "The patient was recumbent on the hospital bed."

[Upstanding] – ईमानदार – Honest and morally upright
Example: "He is known as an upstanding citizen in his community."

[Review] – समीक्षा – A formal assessment or examination
Example: "The manager will review the report before submission."

[Upright] – सीधा – Vertical or morally correct
Example: "She sat upright in her chair during the meeting."

[Prostrate] – मुंह के बल लेटा हुआ – Lying flat, especially face downward
Example: "The devotees were prostrate before the deity in prayer."

Conclusion:
"Prostrate" is the best synonym for "recumbent" as both describe a lying-down position, whereas the other options either mean standing ("upright," "upstanding") or are unrelated ("review").

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Remission
(CHSL Exam 2024 Tier I)
options: Overlook
Punishment
Pardon
Retribution
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Pardon

Remission - Pardon

Explanation:
"Remission" refers to the cancellation or reduction of a debt or penalty, and "Pardon" similarly means to forgive or excuse an offense. Both imply the release from a penalty or punishment.
(रिमिशन का अर्थ है किसी ऋण या सजा को रद्द करना या कम करना, और "पार्डन" का अर्थ भी किसी अपराध को क्षमा करना है। दोनों ही सजा से मुक्ति का संकेत देते हैं।)

Other synonyms Words:
Forgiveness, Absolution, Amnesty, Reprieve, Exoneration

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Remission – माफी / क्षमा – The cancellation or reduction of a debt or penalty.
Example: "The prisoner was granted remission for good behavior."

Overlook – अनदेखा करना – To fail to notice or ignore something deliberately.
Example: "The manager decided to overlook the minor mistake."

Punishment – सजा – A penalty imposed for wrongdoing.
Example: "The court sentenced him to severe punishment for the crime."

Retribution – प्रतिशोध – Punishment inflicted as vengeance for a wrong.
Example: "The victim's family demanded retribution for the injustice."

Pardon – क्षमा – The action of forgiving or being forgiven for an offense.
Example: "The governor issued a pardon to the wrongly convicted man."

Conclusion:
"Pardon" is the best synonym for "Remission" as both involve the idea of forgiveness or release from punishment, unlike "Overlook," "Punishment," or "Retribution," which have different meanings.
